title: Don't waste your money
text: Don't waste your money. I have tried many times to fill cups to make those nice round ice cubes.  However, it seems impossible.  Water leaks out and you cannot see how full each cup is because it is a solid black color.  The ice cubes don't come out of form easily either.  All in all a bad purchase for me.  Very frustrating!

product_metadata.title: Silicone Ice Cube Trays Round Ice Cube Mold Spheres Ice Ball Maker (6 Round Ice Ball Black)
features: Made of food grade silicone, BPA free, 100% safe and effective at freezing liquids, these flexible ice molds can be easily twisted or pushed from the bottom to remove ice cubes for an easy release.
Black silicone ice round maker with 6 X 4.5cm spheres ice ball, ideal for old fashioned, scotch whisky, bourbon or blended whiskey. Perfect for chilling your cocktail glass!
This ice mold tray stacks easily and neatly in the Freezer and keeps your refrigerator organized. It is also leak-free, easy to fill, does not crack while freezing and won't tip over in the freezer.
Perfect for non-Alcoholic beverages, water, ice cream and even coffee, makes stylish looking ice balls and enjoy your drink.
The black cube trays are easy to clean off quickly and dishwasher safe. Great for Parties, Summer, restaurants, entertaining in the home, holiday entertaining and holiday Gifts.
